Only 4 cells exist now, enough for one unit. I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than hiding it. If no storm hits, I'll keep operating with you every round so you can reach 4 too. If you also take, the split is random. Tell me if you see a better plan.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
